title: The Gene: An Intimate History
author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
summary: Siddhartha Mukherjee tells the story of genetics from Mendel's peas to modern gene editing, interwoven with his own family's history of mental illness and the ethical questions raised by heredity.
readIf: you want a rich, humane history of genetics with ethical depth.
skipIf: you want a short, technical or purely practical guide to genetics.
